 Tata Steel share price today: Metal stock surges nearly 5% ahead of Q2 results; what's driving the rally?
 Tata Steel share price today: The stock witnessed strong buying interest during the trading session as investors kept an eye on the company's upcoming quarterly earnings.
 Authored by: Shahnaz Parveen 
 Updated Nov 2, 2026 10:57 IST
 Tata Steel share price.
 Tata Steel share price today: Metal major has surged nearly 5 per cent in intraday trade on Monday, putting the metal stock in focus ahead of the company's September quarter results for the financial year 2026-27 (Q2 FY27). Notably, the broader market on Monday has opened on a decent note, with the BSE Sensex surging nearly 800 points and the NSE Nifty 50 approaching the 23,300 mark. The stock witnessed strong buying interest during the trading session as investors kept an eye on the company's upcoming quarterly earnings. The BSE Sensex rose 1000 points, or 1.35 per cent to 75,479.74 at 10:45 am. The NSE Nifty 50 gained 298.50 points or 1.27 per cent to 23,344.40. Why are the stock markets rising today? 
 The rally in Indian equities was supported by easing crude oil prices, renewed hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran conflict, strong quarterly earnings from Reliance Industries and sustained buying by foreign investors. Buying was broad-based in early trade, with oil and gas, public sector banks, auto and metal stocks leading sectoral gains. Reliance Industries, Tata Steel , NTPC and Maruti Suzuki were among the prominent gainers during the session. Also Read | 750% dividend alert: Pharma company’s record date this week; when will shareholders get payment? Tata Steel Q2 results date 
 Tata Steel is scheduled to announce its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 7, 2026. What to watch in Tata Steel Q2 results? 
 Investors are expected to track the company's revenue, profitability and operating performance in the September quarter. Steel production and deliveries, realisations, raw material costs and the performance of its European operations will also remain important factors. Tata Steel Q1 results 2026
On July 30, Tata Steel had reported a 19 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 2,385.24 crore in the June quarter on account of growth in revenues from India operations. It had clocked a net profit of Rs 2,007.36 crore in the first quarter of the preceding 2025-26 financial year. Tata Steel stock performance
Tata Steel surges 4.48 per cent to 175.11, nearing day’s high of 175.32 on Monday.
